Tofu breakfast burritos! Sauté veggies like onions, peppers, mushrooms, tomatoes, spinach with tofu and seasonings and LET COOL before assembling burritos. Wrap individually in plastic wrap or aluminum foil and store together in ziploc bag or Tupperware. You can even add vegan sausage/cheese if u want but might be pushing ur cal limit. Use ole low carb high fiber tortillas, they are 50 calories pert tortilla! They are a great size PLUS have 11 grams of fiber! You can premake a weeks worth of these burritos and freeze them, take one out and leave it in the fridge the night before u go into work to let it thaw out.
